definitions.explanation: An educational system where students study primarily at home through mail, online resources, or periodic in-person sessions rather than attending school daily.

examples.japanese: {通信制|つうしんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I attend a correspondence high school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{通信制|つうしんせい}{大学|だいがく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I am studying at a correspondence university while working.

examples.japanese: {通信制|つうしんせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペース→ペース：11173_peesu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}できる→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利点|りてん}→利点：11787_riten⟧だ。
examples.english: The advantage of distance learning is that you can study at your own pace.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used as a modifier before educational institutions: {通信制|つうしんせい}⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧ (correspondence high school) and {通信制|つうしんせい}{大学|だいがく} (correspondence university). Japan has a well-established system of {通信制|つうしんせい} schools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信制|つうしんせい}⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧ (correspondence high school)
- {通信制|つうしんせい}{大学|だいがく} (correspondence university)
- {通信制|つうしんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧ (correspondence course)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{全日制|ぜんにちせい}→全日制：27057_zennichisei⟧: full-time (school) system
- ⟦{定時制|ていじせい}→定時制：19786_teijisei⟧: part-time (evening) school system
